request.state: Choose how a compiler should handle intrinsic emitted-output representation exhaustion. Its line writer exposes infallible push, append and finish; each stored line number is one-based u32. Production entry/package and behavior-example modules share that writer. The map builder is public and infallible, converts slice row positions to zero-based u32 and delegates encoding to sourcemap9.3.2. The library encodes all raw u32 coordinates exactly but uses MAX as the missing source/name sentinel: only IDs0..MAX-1 identify real entries. Its intern tables narrow lengths unchecked. Source input admission legitimately permits a final SourceIdMAX; this source cannot become a real map library ID. Exact repeated-name reuse still belongs to library interning. The driver already reports emission diagnostics and can return an artifact with no executable modules, and CLI blocks artifacts with errors. Compare the alternatives for complete failure visibility, endpoint correctness, compatibility and smallest justified change. No arbitrary byte/resource cap, huge allocation probe, test-only capacity switch, panic-based production control flow or new verification/proof artifact is requested. General allocation/OOM policy is separate; this repair is numeric representability. Advice must not invent external compatibility or consensus.

output_admission.instructions: Assess all alternatives against the same exact domains, complete production refusal, current public compatibility, repeated-name correctness and implementation simplicity. Select one; uncertainty remains advice.

criteria.writer_status: Check push/append numeric capacity before any buffer/line mutation; retain the first writer capacity error and stop writing. Add fallible writer finish that refuses partial output; existing finish remains a documented deterministic-panic compatibility convenience. Migrate every shipped entry/package/BDD finisher to that path, report E6012 and make the public compile driver return no executable artifact on capacity failure. Add fallible map build with prechecks for row/source/name domains and an infallible compatibility wrapper; migrate shipped assembly to its error path. Avoid per-emission-call Result plumbing, but status must propagate from appended failed writers and all finishers must be closed.
criteria.fallible_each_write: Add checked try_push/try_append/try_finish and try_build returning explicit errors before mutation, retain old public conveniences delegating with documented panic on invalid range. Propagate Result from every private emitter call, package and BDD path to the actual driver and return no executable artifact with E6012. Exact map row/source/name bounds and repeated-name reuse remain independently guarded. Failure becomes immediately explicit in signatures, with more Result propagation across many already infallible emission helpers.
criteria.widen_writer: Migrate public generated line carriers and writer arithmetic to u64/usize, preserving exact ordinary output. Add explicit fallible admission at source-map u32 coordinate and MAX-sentinel ID boundaries; either refuse wider outputs there with empty-artifact E6012 or replace the map backend/wire-domain contract in a separate coordinated migration. Avoid writer u32 exhaustion but change public carrier types and still require graceful final-consumer refusal. This does not claim an unlimited map/resource domain.
